items.difficulty_reason: The counted proposition is the author proposition at source lines 482-488: multiplication is lambda definable by the term Mult equalling the abstraction that applies a to (b f) and then to x. The author proof (490-501) is a complete reduction walk: applying Mult to Church numerals n and m reduces to an abstraction applying the numeral n to (m-numeral applied to f) and x; since the numeral m applied to f iterates f m times, the composed iteration applies f to x exactly n times m times, i.e., n times m times; and the resulting normal form is exactly the Church numeral of the product. The reduction chain and the iteration count are both carried in the proof; the later editorial note on eta-reduction and the exercise on an alternative term are outside the counted proof.
